Package org.technoready.researcherdataintegration.controller

Class ArticleController

java.lang.Object
org.technoready.researcherdataintegration.controller.ArticleController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/article") public class ArticleController extends Object
REST Controller responsible for managing article-related operations. Provides endpoints for retrieving stored articles and importing new articles from researchers. DATE: 08 - October - 2025 This controller exposes two main endpoints: - GET /api/article/articles: Retrieves all articles stored in the database - POST /api/article/import: Imports articles for specified researchers Base URL: /api/article

    • getAllArticles

      @GetMapping("/articles") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<Article>> getAllArticles()
      Retrieves all articles stored in the database. Endpoint: GET /api/article/articles Example: GET http://localhost:8080/api/article/articles
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity<List
      > - HTTP 200 OK with list of all articles

    • importArticles

      @PostMapping("/import") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<ImportResponseDTO> importArticles(@RequestBody ImportRequestDTO request)
      Imports articles for specified researchers and stores them in the database. Endpoint: POST /api/article/import Example: POST http://localhost:8080/api/article/import Request Body example: { "researchers": ["Andrew Ng", "Geoffrey Hinton"], "articlesPerResearcher": 3 } CURL example: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/article/import \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"researchers":["Andrew Ng"],"articlesPerResearcher":3}'
      Parameters:
      request - ImportRequestDTO - Contains list of researcher names and articles per researcher
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity - HTTP 201 CREATED with import summary and article list
